nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable contract, set at construction and updated by renounce/transfer ownership.
Ownable constructor: sets _owner = msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
View returning the current _owner address.
View/guard returning whether msg.sender equals _owner; used by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently removing owner privileges.
onlyOwner function forwarding newOwner to _transferOwnership.
Internal routine validating newOwner != 0 and writing the new owner.
Address parameter of transferOwnership passed through to _transferOwnership.
Address parameter written into the _owner state variable.
Caller address used to bootstrap ownership and to authorise onlyOwner functions.
ERC20Interface handle to the DAI token contract, replaceable by the owner via initDai.
UniswapInterface handle to the Uniswap exchange contract, replaceable by the owner via initUniswap.
Public mapping(bytes32 steamid => uint256 amount) tracking credited user deposits.
Deploys the bot: stores DAI and Uniswap addresses and grants unlimited DAI allowance to Uniswap.
onlyOwner setter that points DaiContract at an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner setter that points UniswapContract at an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner wrapper calling DaiContract.approve with an arbitrary spender/amount.
Payable deposit swapping ETH into an exact token output through Uniswap, refunding leftover ETH to the caller.
Payable deposit swapping all sent ETH into tokens through Uniswap and crediting the steamid.
Pulls DAI from the caller via transferFrom and credits the deposit mapping.
onlyOwner function selling contract tokens for ETH and forwarding the proceeds to an arbitrary recipient.
onlyOwner function transferring contract DAI to an arbitrary address.
Payable fallback that only accepts plain ETH transfers with empty calldata.
onlyOwner function transferring the entire ETH balance to the caller.
Caller that supplies msg.value and receives the ETH refund in depositOutput.
Caller that supplies msg.value in depositInput.
Caller whose DAI balance is debited via transferFrom in depositDai.
Owner caller that receives the whole contract balance in cashOut.
External payable call into the Uniswap contract before the deposit accounting is finalised; can reenter or manipulate refund accounting.
ETH refund transfer to an untrusted caller after an external call in depositOutput.
External payable call into the Uniswap contract in depositInput, executed before the deposit mapping is updated.
External ERC20 call transferring caller DAI into the contract; the token address is owner-controlled and can callback.
External ERC20 approve call granting an arbitrary spender an arbitrary allowance.
External Uniswap call selling contract tokens and sending the resulting ETH to an arbitrary recipient.
External ERC20 transfer of contract DAI to an arbitrary address.
ETH transfer of the full contract balance to the owner, executed with no reentrancy guard.
DAI token address passed to the constructor.
Uniswap exchange address passed to the constructor.
New DAI contract address written into DaiContract.
New Uniswap contract address written into UniswapContract.

Allowance amount passed to DaiContract.approve.

Exact token amount requested from Uniswap and credited in depositOutput.
Uniswap trade deadline forwarded by depositOutput.

Minimum tokens accepted from the Uniswap swap in depositInput.

DAI amount pulled from the caller and credited to the deposit.
Amount of tokens sold on Uniswap by sendEth.
Minimum ETH accepted from the Uniswap sale.
Uniswap trade deadline forwarded by sendEth.
Arbitrary address receiving the ETH proceeds from sendEth.
Steam identifier emitted in the Purchase event.
Offer identifier emitted in the Purchase event.
Arbitrary destination of the DAI transfer in sendDai.
DAI amount transferred out by sendDai.
Steam identifier emitted in the Purchase event.
Offer identifier emitted in the Purchase event.
ETH actually consumed by the Uniswap ethToTokenTransferOutput call.
msg.value minus eth_sold, returned to the caller as change.
Token amount returned by the Uniswap ethToTokenTransferInput call.
ETH amount returned by the Uniswap tokenToEthTransferInput call.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to initialise the owner.
msg.sender is written into _owner, establishing unrestricted ownership of the deployment.
isOwner compares msg.sender against _owner to gate privileged functions.
isOwner reads the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking isOwner.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier invoking isOwner.
transferOwnership forwards its newOwner parameter.
transferOwnership delegates the state change to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership consumes its newOwner parameter.
newOwner becomes the new _owner, transferring full control of the contract.
initDai is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
initUniswap is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
setAllowance is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
sendEth is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
sendDai is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
cashOut is restricted by onlyOwner/isOwner.
Constructor calls initDai to configure the DAI handle.
Constructor calls initUniswap to configure the Uniswap handle.
Constructor calls setAllowance granting Uniswap an unlimited DAI allowance.
Constructor consumes the _daiAddress parameter.
Constructor consumes the _uniswapAddress parameter.
_daiAddress flows into the DaiContract state variable.
_uniswapAddress flows into the UniswapContract state variable.
initDai consumes its _address parameter.
Owner-supplied address is written into DaiContract.
initUniswap consumes its _address parameter.
Owner-supplied address is written into UniswapContract.
setAllowance consumes the _address spender parameter.
setAllowance consumes the _amount parameter.
Spender address is forwarded to the external approve call.
Allowance amount is forwarded to the external approve call.
setAllowance performs an external call to the DAI contract.
setAllowance reads the DaiContract state variable to perform the approve.
Untrusted caller invokes depositOutput.
_steamid is used as the deposits mapping key.
_tokens_bought is passed to the external Uniswap call.
_deadline is passed to the external Uniswap call.
depositOutput makes an external payable Uniswap call before finalising accounting.
eth_sold is the return value of the external Uniswap call.
refund is computed as msg.value - eth_sold, relying on SafeMath-free subtraction semantics.
The refund value drives an ETH transfer to the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refund transfer.
The ETH transfer hands control to msg.sender, enabling reentrancy into deposit functions.
_tokens_bought is added into the deposits mapping for the given steamid.
depositOutput writes the credited deposit balance.
Untrusted caller invokes depositInput.
_steamid is used as the deposits mapping key.
_min_tokens is passed to the external Uniswap call.
_deadline is passed to the external Uniswap call.
depositInput performs an external payable Uniswap call before updating accounting.
tokens_bought is the return value of the external Uniswap call.
tokens_bought is added into the deposits mapping for the given steamid.
depositInput writes the credited deposit balance.
Untrusted caller invokes depositDai.
_steamid is used as the deposits mapping key.
_amount is forwarded to the external transferFrom call.
msg.sender is the source address of the external transferFrom call.
depositDai makes an external call into the owner-controlled token contract.
The external token call can reenter depositDai before the deposit is recorded.
_amount is added into the deposits mapping for the given steamid.
depositDai writes the credited deposit balance.
_tokens_sold is passed to the external Uniswap call.
_min_eth is passed to the external Uniswap call.
_deadline is passed to the external Uniswap call.
Arbitrary _recipient is used as the destination of the external Uniswap ETH payout.
sendEth performs an external Uniswap call transferring value to an arbitrary address.
eth_bought is the return value of the external Uniswap call.
Value is pushed to the caller-supplied recipient, giving it execution control.
_steamid is emitted in the Purchase event.
_offerid is emitted in the Purchase event.
_address is used as the destination of the external DAI transfer.
_amount is the value of the external DAI transfer.
sendDai makes an external call into the token contract with a caller-specified destination.
The external token call can reenter the contract.
_steamid is emitted in the Purchase event.
_offerid is emitted in the Purchase event.
Owner caller invokes cashOut.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full contract balance.
cashOut performs an ETH transfer of the entire balance without a reentrancy guard.
The ETH transfer hands execution control to msg.sender.
